## API / Data Source

How does the board serve job listings? (Check all that apply)

- [ ] HTML pages with structured listings
- [ ] JSON API (known endpoint: )
- [ ] RSS/Atom feed

## Priority

- [ ] **High**: board has unique job listings not found elsewhere
- [ ] **Medium**: overlaps with existing boards but has good volume
- [ ] **Low**: nice-to-have

## Additional Context

- Does the board require authentication?
- Are there known rate limits?
- Is there a public API documentation link?
- Any existing open-source scrapers for this board?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before filing this request
- [ ] The board is a legitimate job board (not aggregator/spam)
- [ ] The board has public listings (no login wall)
